feeds.title: The Labour Market Information Council (LMIC) Blog
feeds.description: The Labour Market Information Council blog is about understanding the labour market needs of Canadians. Our mission is to empower Canadians to make informed decisions by enabling access to quality, relevant and comprehensive data and insights across the pan-Canadian LMI ecosystem.

feeds.title: Labor 411 Blog
feeds.description: Visit our blog to learn about the Labor related decisions made by the government and more. Labor 411 believes that by making the choice to spend our money on products and services that are made in our country by workers who are treated fairly, and paid living wages, we are helping to protect the middle class, strengthen our national economy and build a stronger America.

feeds.title: Oxford University Labour Club Blog
feeds.description: Read the blogs written by the Oxford University Labour Club students and committee members. The Oxford University Labour Club is the largest and oldest university Labour club in the country. Since 1919 the club has been the home of the Labour movement at Oxford, hosting prominent speakers, interesting panels, and fun socials.

feeds.title: Canadian Labour Congress
feeds.description: Here you will find the publications by the Canadian Labour Congress. The Canadian Labour Congress is the largest labour organization in Canada, bringing together dozens of national and international unions, provincial and territorial federations of labour and community-based labour councils to represent more than 3 million workers across the country.

feeds.title: UnionTrack Blog
feeds.description: The UnionTrack blog provides the readers with Labor Union News, Insight and Tools. Our proven technology unifies union operations. We enable unions to allocate more of their resources toward organizing, training, and advocating.

feeds.title: UK Labour Law Blog
feeds.description: Here you can read articles about Labour Law related incidents and stories, as well as information related to the Labour Law. Supported by UCL Laws, UK Labour Law is a forum for academics, practising lawyers and those engaged in labour law policies to provide expert analysis of labour law matters.

feeds.title: Union Built PC Blog
feeds.description: Stay updated with information related to the Labor Law with the Union Built PC blog. Union Built PC is committed to providing International and Local Unions, the organizations affiliated with them, and all Union Members, Computer Hardware and Software completely customized to your specific requirements.

feeds.title: OnLabor
feeds.description: OnLabor is a blog dev­oted to workers, unions, and their politics. We in­ter­pret our sub­ject broadly to in­clude the cur­rent cri­sis in the tra­di­tional union move­ment, the new and con­tested forms of worker or­ga­ni­za­tion that are fill­ing the la­bor union gap, how work ought to be struc­tured and man­aged, how work­ers ought to be rep­re­sented and com­pen­sated, and the ap­pro­pri­ate role of gov­ern­ment.

feeds.title: Labor Relations Update
feeds.description: The Labor Relations Update is written by the Proskauer Rose Labor Management Group and gives updates on labor & employment issues. Our Labor-Management Relations Group, with its distinguished history of representing management in the private, not-for-profit and public spheres is in the singular position to leverage our long and unique history for all of our clients' futures.

feeds.title: ILOSTAT Blog
feeds.description: The ILOSTAT blog provides the latest labour statistics trends through visualizations as well as insights into methodological issues. The ILO Department of Statistics is the focal point to the United Nations on labour statistics. We develop international standards for better measurement of labour issues and enhanced international comparability.

feeds.title: LaborPress
feeds.description: LaborPress brings to you Daily Labor Union News. LaborPress is New York's leading source for daily labor news and industry information and now covers labor news across the country.

feeds.title: BC Labour Heritage Blog
feeds.description: The BC Labour Heritage blog gives the readers articles on Labour movements in the past and today. The BC Labour Heritage Centre Society was founded in 2004 with JJ Munro as Chair. The Society preserves, documents and presents the rich history of working people in British Columbia.

feeds.title: Labor Notes
feeds.description: Labor Notes is a network of rank-and-file members, local union leaders, and labor activists who know the labor movement is worth fighting for. We encourage connections between workers in different unions, workers centers, communities, industries, and countries to strengthen the movement from the bottom up.

feeds.title: Labour Behind the Label Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest news by and read about the companies that we call out. Labour Behind the Label is a campaign that works to improve conditions and empower workers in the global garment industry. We support garment workers' efforts worldwide to improve their working conditions and change the fashion industry for the better.

feeds.title: John's Labour Blog
feeds.description: A blog about Labour movement, trade unions, pensions, housing and councils. John's Labour is a personal blog by John Gray. He is the UNISON National Convenor & London Regional Council Officer.

feeds.title: Barteaux Labour and Employment Lawyers Blog
feeds.description: We hope our workplace tips and updates on labour and employment law are helpful to you and your organization. We provide egal expertise to help employers solve workplace issues. At Barteaux, we value the best of the legal tradition, but we practice law a little differently. We've moved away from the traditional siloed approach to client management. The whole team is at your service.

feeds.title: Jon's Labour Movement Blog
feeds.description: This is Jon Roger's personal blog. He was Branch Secretary of Lambeth UNISON and a member of the National Executive Council (NEC) of UNISON, the public service union. He is now a retired member of UNISON. Jon is Chair of Brighton Pavilion Constituency Labour Party and a member of the Labour Representation Committee (LRC).

feeds.title: Luke's Blog
feeds.description: A blog by Luke Akehurst about politics, elections, and the Labour Party. Luke is a Labour Party activist since 1988 - firmly on the moderate wing of the party. He is also a member of Labour's NEC 2010-2012 and since 2020.

feeds.title: Alasdair Ross Blog
feeds.description: I am Alasdair Ross - local councillor. In this blog I will be giving my political opinions on both issues at home and abroad. I will also focus on the issues that affect the people of Ipswich and in particular those who live in Rushmere Ward. I will also try and give an insight to how I will be campaigning in Rushmere and Ipswich as we fight against the savage cuts imposed by this Tory Government.

feeds.title: Labour in Communications
feeds.description: Read about the thoughts, views and ideas from our members on topics that matter the most to them. Labour in Communications is Labour's fastest-growing professional network of supporters working in the communications, media and public affairs industry.

feeds.title: Blogs - Ascent
feeds.description: For the last 16 years, Ascent has been delivering flexible & quick HR software solutions. We assure you of constant value addition and innovation to help HR teams work smarter. From the development to the delivery of each product, we prioritize serving your business needs to the best. Stay updated with the latest trends and insights in the world of HR and payroll management on our informative blogs.

feeds.title: SLU Blog
feeds.description: The School of Labor and Urban Studies (SLU) comes out of a singular collaboration among labor unions, city workers, community organizations and academic institutions and their faculty and staff. Our blog is a window into this dynamic intellectual and politically engaging community.

feeds.title: Lawson Lundell LLP
feeds.description: Lawson Lundell's Labour and Employment Law Blog provides updates on the most recent legal developments impacting the Canadian workplace and offers practical tips for employers. We cover a range of topics, including labour relations, employment law, collective bargaining, human rights, employment standards and various other topics.

feeds.title: The Alberta Federation of Labour Blog
feeds.description: Check-out the posts at AFL and their updates about labour. The Alberta Federation of Labour is a voluntary association of unions and employee organizations that have banded together to achieve common goals.
